title: Republic Day greeting 2027
hook: Happy Republic Day from all of us at Galvor.
caption:
Happy Republic Day from all of us at Galvor.

Today we remember the day India gave itself a Constitution, and the people who wrote down what kind of country this would be.

Wishing you a proud and peaceful 26th of January, a good view of the parade and a day off well spent.

Jai Hind.
alt_text: Festival card in Galvor violet and gold with a sparkle motif. It reads Happy Republic Day, then: proud of where we build, grateful for those who built before us. Below: Jai Hind, from all of us at Galvor.

slides.headline: Proud of where we build. *Grateful* to those who built before us.
slides.sub: Jai Hind, from all of us at Galvor.

notes:
Greeting only, no sale or marketing tie-in. Sparkle motif because flag emoji do not render in the image template. No numbers used.
